findings.description: The customer-managed KMS key that protects the audit bucket data does not set enable_key_rotation, which defaults to false. Because the backing key material is never rotated, a compromised or leaked key remains usable against all data it has historically encrypted, and the configuration fails common benchmarks (e.g. CIS AWS 3.8) that require periodic rotation of customer-managed CMKs.
